What this supports

The report records factual findings from the specified agreed procedures on institutional claims and supporting records.

Scope & limits

An agreed-upon-procedures report is not an assurance opinion. Readers need the complete procedures, criteria and findings to assess its meaning. It does not establish clinical outcomes.

Restricted-use source. A UDIN lookup authenticates document particulars; it does not expand the report’s scope.
